NALANDA SHILPGRAM: ₹500 Invest, ₹5000 Profit! CHEAPEST Wholesale Crafts Market | Moggalana Bihar
Welcome to my latest travel and business vlog! Today, we are exploring a hidden gem in Bihar: the Moggalana Craft Village (Nalanda Shilpgram). This incredible place is not just a key site for Nalanda Tourism but also a secret Wholesale Market for Handicrafts that can kickstart your next business venture!
